My dear [Sir William](/person/669)-
Your letter has come on to me here. I came on Monday to be instructed respecting[ Bishop Patteson](/person/1155)'s life, which I am to try to [draw up](/book/102) from the very full materials that his family and [Bishop Selwyn](/person/1295) can provide. I hope to return on Saturday.

Thank you for letting me see [Mr.

Faithfull](/person/497)'s decision; I think he is wise to give his name, and so obtain the subscriptions of all his friends. I daresay in this way he will obtain a good
deal of pleasure out of it himself, and I hope some benefit to the hospital funds.-[^1]
Your affectionate
C. M. YONGE.


[^1]: Edward Williams Faithfull, Occasional Thoughts (London, E.

Faithfull, and Winchester, Jacob and Johnson 1872), a volume of verse published by private subscription, probably in aid of the rebuilt [Royal Hampshire Hospital](/organisation/36) in Winchester.
